wavelength_reference: air (standard dry air: Ciddor 1996, 15 C, 101325 Pa, CO2 450 umol/mol; scripts/sosfuse2/air_wavelength.py)
definition: 0.1 nm cell means [x-0.05, x+0.05] of the source linear interpolant on the spectra_fine.json grid, 7 significant digits; band means integrate this grid with the trapezoid rule (spectral.py), point values interpolate it (a filtered spectrum, like the solar column).

rules.blend: linear C_97 -> CP6 over the window, on the union of both sample grids
rules.columns_doc: BIRA dataset page: CP_97 columns 3-7 = p < 0.015, 0.03, 0.04, 0.16, 0.25 Torr

source.name: Vandaele et al. 1998, NO2 220 K (BIRA-IASB)
source.dataset: Robert, S., Vandaele, A. C., Hermans, C. (2026). NO2 absorption cross sections at different temperatures and pressures (Version 1). Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy. https://doi.org/10.18758/6b80spv8
source.reference: Vandaele, A. C. et al. (1998). JQSRT 59, 171-184.
source.wavelength: column 1 = 1/lambda in air (Edlen 15 C, 101325 Pa), used as the air wavelength

self_check.note: bands above 1 % of the largest band mean
